input.title: Two Similar Transfers
input.request: Mira, the account holder, wants H&V to establish whether two similar outgoing transfer entries are one instruction shown twice or two separate instructions, and asks whether the second can be stopped or returned.

events.text: Your payment activity shows two similar outgoing transfer entries to North Quay Utilities for £84.20. One is marked Completed and the other Pending.

summary: The requester reported two similar outgoing transfers to North Quay Utilities for £84.20, one Completed and one Pending. The desk classified this as a register request about a transfer and registered it with the payment team. Its attempt to look the payments up directly in the payment system was refused, because this type of request has to go to that team as a request. Nothing has been established about whether the two entries are duplicates, and nothing has been stopped or returned, so that review is left to the payment team.
